parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented police targeting, border/custody/facility rules all unresolved (open questions, not exposures), and LGBT organising, Pride events and a protective UN posture are documented positives. But the acceptance evidence is entirely LGB-framed: no survey measures trans acceptance, a 2010 report found SOGI discrimination persisting, the only trans-specific harm is one activist's undated verbal abuse and two attacks, and there is no legal gender recognition or documented remedy (no gender-identity employment protection, name change refused). No tier-1 or tier-2 exposure appears, so the rating rests on scattered dated incidents, societal discrimination and unproven recourse — consistent with the 0.65 anchors, held a step below documented acceptance-plus-working-protections for want of trans-specific evidence.
